step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled NMOS pair that provides negative resistance, commonly used as the active core in LC oscillators (VCOs), active mixers, or latches in RF transceivers.

paper_reference.title: An Ultralow-Power UHF Transceiver Integrated in a Standard Digital CMOS Process: Architecture and Receiver

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the cross-coupled pair and tail current.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Tail current is set to 500uA to match the ~1mW power consumption target from the paper, adjusted for the 1.8V SKY130 supply.

negative_resistance.description: Small-signal differential negative resistance provided by the cross-coupled pair.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = sqrt(2 * u_n * C_ox * (W/L) * I_D) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 250u) = 1.16 mA/V. Rin = -2 / gm = -1724 ohms.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact gm of the SKY130 NMOS at 250uA bias current per branch.

oscillation_frequency.description: Oscillation frequency when loaded with an ideal LC tank (10nH diff, 2pF).

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L_diff * C_tank)) = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(10nH * 2pF)) = 1.12 GHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the 1 GHz frequency reported in the paper, dominated by the external ideal tank components added in the testbench.

voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak differential voltage swing of the oscillator.

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing is limited by the supply voltage and transistor triode regions. Typically 2-3V peak-to-peak for a 1.8V supply with an LC tank.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ideal LC tank allows voltage to swing above VDD, limited only by transistor non-linearities.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, small-signal negative resistance, and transient oscillation of the cross-coupled pair.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Cross-coupled pair testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 N0 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
I_tail N2 0 500u

* LC Tank for oscillation and DC bias
L1 VDD N0 5n
L2 VDD N1 5n
Ctank N0 N1 2p

* AC source for impedance measurement
I_ac N0 N1 DC 0 AC 1

.ic v(N0)=1.8 v(N1)=1.7

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
let dc_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print dc_power

* 2. AC Analysis for Negative Resistance
ac dec 100 100Meg 10Gig
let vdiff = v(N0) - v(N1)
let Y = 1 / vdiff
let Gin = real(Y)
let Rin = 1 / Gin
meas ac Rin_1G find Rin at=1G
meas ac Gin_1G find Gin at=1G
let gm_eff = -Gin_1G * 2
print gm_eff

* 3. Transient Analysis for Oscillation
tran 10p 50n
meas tran v_max max v(N0)
meas tran v_min min v(N0)
let v_swing = v_max - v_min
print v_swing

meas tran t1 trig v(N0) val=1.8 rise=15 targ v(N0) val=1.8 rise=16
let osc_freq = 1 / t1
print osc_freq

quit
.endc
